## Kabelkonfektion in Düsseldorf

Falls Sie auf der Suche nach einem professionellen Hersteller für Ihre Kabelbäume sind, sollten Sie sich unser Leistungsangebot einmal anschauen. Denn EMSsourcing ist Ihr Spezialist für die Kabelkonfektion in Düsseldorf.

Gerne unterstützen wir Sie bereits in der Entwicklungsphase mit der Auswahl geeigneter Kabel und Stecker von führenden Herstellern. Wir produzieren Ihre kundenspezifischen Kabelbäume und Netzkabel in Düsseldorf, lassen aber auch lohnintensivere Zuarbeiten an unserem Standort Wloclawek in Polen durchführen.

Unsere Kabelkonfektion fertigt für Sie Sonderlösungen, Prototypen, Kleinserien und mittlere Bedarfe. Mit vollautomatischen Crimpmaschinen unterstützen wir unsere Industriekunden selbstverständlich auch bei großen Stückzahlen.

EMSsourcing pflegt langjährige Einkaufsbeziehungen mit leistungsfähigen Lieferanten und Herstellern. Damit bieten wir Ihnen Sicherheit in der Materialversorgung und wettbewerbsfähige Preise für Ihre Projekte.

Wir unterhalten ein Qualitätsmanagement-System nach DIN ISO 9001:2015, das durch den TÜV-Rheinland auditiert und zertifiziert wird.

## Prüfmittelbau

Egal ob Funktionstestgerät, Programmier- oder Nadelbettadapter, EMSsourcing fertigt einfache und komplexe elektronische Prüfmittel nach Ihren Vorgaben. Unser erfahrener Prüfmittelbau in Düsseldorf unterstützt Sie bereits in der Entwicklungsphase und beim Prototypenbau. Nach der Industrialisierung und der Freigabe übernimmt dann unsere Prüfmittelfertigung die Serienproduktion Ihrer Geräte.

## Elektrotechnischer Gerätebau

Zu unserem Leistungsspektrum gehört neben der Kabelkonfektion und dem Prüfmittelbau auch der Gerätebau. In Lohndienstleistung übernehmen wir für unsere Kunden die Verkabelung und Montage elektronischer Baugruppen und Systeme.

Auf Wunsch, übernimmt unsere Gerätefertigung in Düsseldorf für Sie die komplette Wertschöpfungskette der Geräte- und Baugruppenherstellung, inklusive einer externen Leiterplattenbestückung in Polen.

## Leistungsüberblick EMSsourcing

Konstruieren. Beschaffen. Fertigen. Prüfen. Dokumentieren. Verpacken.
Wettbewerbsfähige Dienstleistung für Ihre Produkte und Ihren Unternehmenserfolg!

## EMSsourcing investiert in die Kabelkonfektion

20.07.2020
EMSsourcing hat am Fertigungsstandort Düsseldorf einen neuen Crimp-Vollautomaten für die Kabelkonfektion in Betrieb genommen. Der Spezialist für kunden-spezifische Kabelgarnituren ist vom Preis/Leistungsverhältnis des Herstellers KMI begeistert. „Die EXTREME ist nun schon unsere zweite Maschine des italienischen Herstellers KMI“, erläutert Frank Unland, Geschäftsführer von EMSsourcing. Ausgerüstet mit zwei Crimp-Köpfen und einer Verzinn-Station können wir nun vollautomatisch bis zu 2000 Litzen mit angeschlagenen Crimp-Kontakten zusätzlich pro Stunde fertigen. Mit dieser Investition werden wir der extrem gestiegenen Nachfrage unserer Kunden gerecht und entlasten zudem unser Fertigungspersonal“. Kunden aus der Medizin- und Messtechnik profitieren bereits von der neu gewonnenen Kapazität.

EMSsourcing wurde im Bereich Herstellung und Vertrieb kundenspezifischer Kabelgarnituren (Kabelkonfektion) durch den TÜV Rheinland erfolgreich nach ISO9001:2015 zertifiziert.

Our rotary stripping machines from SCHLEUNIGER and RITTMEYER guarantee fast and precise removal of cable insulation without damaging the inner conductors. Soldering work and the assembly of connectors are of course left to the trained hand.

We assemble products from AMPHENOL, BINDER, HARTING, HIRSCHMANN, LAPP, MONACOR, NEUTRIK, PHOENIX, PFLITSCH, SCHURTER, WAGO and WÜRTH, among others.

## Ribbon cable

At EMSsourcing we process more than 10 km of ribbon cable per year. The majority are cables with the cross-section AWG28/AWG26, to which we attach pin, micro-match and DSUB connectors using insulation displacement connection technology (IDC).

Of course, we also assemble ribbon cables with crimp contacts, ferrites and EMC shielding.

We assemble products from TE CONNECTIVITY, WÜRTH, HARTING, FCI, ECON, AMPHENOL and CONEC, among others.

## Coaxial cable

Our rotary stripping machines from KOMAX and SCHLEUNIGER strip coaxial cables cleanly and in reproducible quality.

Short cycle times ensure cost-optimized production, even for larger quantities.

Among others, RG58, RG178, RG223 and RG316 coaxial cables are processed, which are provided with SMA, MCX, N, F and BNC connectors.

We assemble products from HUBER+SUHNER, SAMTEC, TELEGÄRTNER, TE CONNECTIVITY and WÜRTH, among others.

## Test and programming adapters built according to your specifications

## Needle bed adapters and functional test equipment

We have many years of experience in the construction and wiring of functional test equipment. Most of the devices are needle bed adapters which are used in the production plants of two German premium brands of the automotive industry.

The DUT (the assembled electronic board) is contacted with the test adapter via needles and plugs. For optimized process times, two test adapters are usually installed in one test cabinet. An integrated test PC takes over the pneumatic and electronic control and tests the proper function of the test fixture. After successful testing, the electronic board is released for further processing in the vehicle.

At EMSsourcing, trained employees wire the very complex test adapters with up to 800 cable connections according to the specifications in our customers’ circuit documents.

## Prüf- und Programmieradapter gebaut nach Ihren Vorgaben

Kontakt

## Prüfmittelbau und Nadelbettadapter

Bei EMSsourcing in Düsseldorf hat unser Prüfmittelbau eine langjährige Erfahrung im Aufbau und der Verdrahtung von Funktionsprüfmitteln. Dabei handelt es sich in der Regel um Nadelbettadapter die in den Fertigungswerken deutscher Premiummarken der Automobilindustrie zum Einsatz kommen.

Der Prüfling (die bestückte Elektronikplatine) wird über Nadeln und Stecker mit dem Testadapter kontaktiert. Für optimierte Prozesszeiten werden in der Regel zwei Prüfadapter in einen Testschrank verbaut. Ein integrierter Prüf-PC übernimmt die pneumatische- und elektronische Steuerung und testet die einwandfreie Funktion des Prüflings. Nach der erfolgreichen Prüfung wird die Elektronikplatine zur weiteren Verarbeitung im Fahrzeug freigegeben.

In unserem Prüfmittelbau verdrahten geschulte Mitarbeiter die sehr komplexen Prüfadapter mit bis zu 800 Kabelverbindungen nach den Vorgaben in den Schaltungsunterlagen unserer Kunden.

# Ladeinfrastruktur

* * *

Der erste Eichrechtskonforme Gleichstromzähler GSH01 wurde von der DZG Metering in Oranienburg entwickelt. Mit dieser neuen Innovation kann die direkte Nutzung von Gleichstrom bis 1000 V und 650 A eichrechtskonform gezählt werden.

Die Gleichstromzähler Varianten sind für die  DIN Rail (Hutschienen) Montage konzipiert. Die Berechnung der kompensierte Energie erfolgt durch den Leitungswiderstand oder durch eine zusätzliche Spannungsmessung. Verwendung findet das OCMF (Open Charge Metering Format) unter Beachtung der Kompatibilität mit der S.A.F.E. Transparenzsoftware. Die Versendung der Informationen zu den Ladevorgängen erfolgt mit einer digitalen Signatur.

Die DZG Metering geht mit Ihrem Gleichstromzählern weiter konsequent den Weg als Lösungsanbieter für die Anforderungen der Energiewende.

  * GSH6080
  * GSH4020
  * GSH6225
  * GSH02
  * GSH01
  * DWH4513

### GSH6080

Der DC-Zähler GSH6080 ist für DIN Rail Montage (Hutschienen) konzipiert und berechnet die kompensierte Energie durch den Leitungswiderstand.

# Zertifizierte Prüfstelle EBB1

* * *

Punktgenau und zertifiziert.

Bei digitalen Messgeräten kommt es auf Genauigkeit an. Um diese zu gewährleisten, betreibt die DZG am Standort Oranienburg die durch das Landesamt für Mess- und Eichwesen Berlin-Brandenburg zertifizierte Prüfstelle EBB1.

Ihr Vorteil liegt in der Eichung von elektronischen und mechanischen Zählern aller Fabrikate sowie dem Eichen diverser elektronischer Zusatzeinrichtung. Des Weiteren unterstützen wir Sie mit Befundprüfungen und erstellen auf Wunsch Gutachten.

Kurzum bieten wir als Prüfstelle sämtliche Dienstleistungen und Services für Energieversorger und Messstellenbetreiber aus einer Hand.

Bleiben Sie zuverlässig.

# Leistungen der Prüfstelle

* * *

### Eichen von Messgeräten

Innerstaatliche Eichungen an elektronischen und mechanischen Zählern, Eichungen an instandgesetzten mechanischen, Hybrid- und vollelektronischen Zählern aller Hersteller und Fabrikate. Eichen von elektronischen Zusatzeinrichtungen.

 

### Stichprobenprüfung

## New Enerday

The company was founded as a management-buy-out of an experienced development team by Dr. Matthias Boltze in 2010, that’s roots go back to fuel cell development activities in the early 2000s at Webasto in Neubrandenburg.

Continuous improvement and evolutionary development were the drivers to create the REMOTE 250 and REMOTE 500 Propane fuel cell models in 2025, to cover a wide range of applications with average loads between 60 and 1.800 W.

## Geschichte

Die Geschichte des Erfolges begann im Jahr 1910 in Nürnberg. Hans Dehn gründete dort am 21. Januar sein Elektroinstallationsunternehmen. Schon früh setzte er sich mit der Problematik des Blitzschutzes auseinander. Bereits 1918 veröffentlichte er sein erstes Patent zu diesem Thema und begann selbst mit der Produktion von Blitzschutzbauteilen.

 

Heute blickt Dehn auf eine 100-jährige erfolgreiche Unternehmensgeschichte zurück. ## Über HEGLER

Die HEGLER-Gruppe ist ein familiengeführtes Industrieunternehmen mit dem Fokus auf der Fertigung von materialsparenden Profilrohrlösungen aus polymeren Werkstoffen sowie auf dem Bau von Extrusionsanlagen zur Herstellung von Well- und Verbundrohren. Die Kernkompetenz liegt in der Extrusionstechnologie für ein breites Sortiment an Rohr- und Schachtsystemen inkl. Systemzubehör für den Einsatz im Hoch- und Tiefbau sowie in der Industrie.

## Geschichte

1949 wurde das Unternehmen in Oerlenbach/Unterfranken von Herrn Ing. grad. Wilhelm Hegler gegründet und mit der Entwicklung und Produktion von Elektroinstallationsrohren begonnen. Anfänglich wurden diese Rohrtypen zunächst aus Stahlblech mit bituminösen Einlagen hergestellt. Bereits Mitte der 1950er Jahre wurde durch eine äußere Umhüllung aus coextrudiertem PVC eine Korrosionsschutzvariante ergänzt. Dies war auch der Beginn des Kunststoffzeitalters in Oerlenbach.

 

Aufgrund der fortschreitenden Entwicklung bei polymeren Werkstoffen wurden sehr schnell die Vorzüge dieser Werkstoffe für eine effiziente, wirtschaftliche und praxisgerechte Produktion von unterschiedlichsten Rohrqualitäten erkannt und umgesetzt. Der Produktionsschwerpunkt liegt heute in der Well- und Verbundrohrtechnologie für ein breites Sortiment an Rohr-, Zubehör- und Schachtsystemen, die ihren Einsatz im Hoch-, Tiefbau und in der Industrietechnik finden. Die Produktion erfolgt dabei auf Extrusionslinien, für die die Kernkomponenten im eigenen Maschinenbau entwickelt und hergestellt werden. Jahrzehnte lange Erfahrungen in der Extrusion und im Maschinenbau stehen für Qualität, Langlebigkeit und die praxisgerechte Anwendung aller von uns gefertigten Produkte.

 

Das Unternehmen wird heute in der zweiten Generation von Dr.-Ing. Ralph P. Hegler geführt.

### Laser and laser pattern projectors for true to scale positioning

Laser projectors from LAP  display true-to-scale outlines, templates, shapes, or patterns generated by CAD data. On flat, curved, or structured surfaces, they project outlines of one or several objects that have to be placed, aligned, or nested. Industrial laser projection systems generate virtual but visible templates that don't touch or soil the surface.

The laser projection system has to be calibrated before starting to work. Reference points are exactly measured positions with reflecting targets. If the tool is known to the system and positioned within the monitoring area of the supporting camera system, the calibration can be triggered and executed automatically.

Gribere anvendes som endeeffektorer til robotter og andre automatiske maskiner og kan opdeles i pneumatiske og motoriserede gribere i henhold til deres funktionsprincip. Pneumatiske gribere er meget udbredt på grund af deres enkle funktionsprincip, men Oriental Motor’s EH-serie af elektriske gribere i kombination med AZ-seriens stepmotorer tilbyder en række interessante fordele, især med hensyn til følsomhed og kontrol af gribeprocessen.

De udbredte pneumatiske gribere er lette, billige og nemme at betjene, men det er vanskeligt at justere gribekraften og hastigheden præcist. Når disse egenskaber er vigtige, har elektriske gribere en klar fordel, fordi de giver brugeren mulighed for at justere gribseraften, hastigheden og positionen præcist i forhold til emnet. Dette forhindrer ikke kun pludselig påvirkning af arbejdsemnet, men gribekraften og cyklustiden optimeres også. Motorens position kan bruges til at fastslå, om der er et emne til stede, og hvis det er tilfældet, kan dets dimensioner også kontrolleres. I den elektriske griber i EH-serien tjener AZ-stepmotoren som drev og er kombineret med en griber og en tandstangsmekanisme. Den største fordel ved denne konstellation er den allerede nævnte mulighed for at justere gribekraften.

# VACUUM

  * ##### A vacuum-technology liquid heatsink is an advanced cooling solution for electronic components, especially CPUs and GPUs.

This type of heatsink operates with a closed circuit containing a coolant, and is distinguished by the use of a vacuum chamber, which enhances heat transfer efficiency.

Vacuum technology enables the liquid to evaporate at lower temperatures, rapidly absorbing heat from the component and transferring it to the radiator for dissipation. Compared to traditional air or conventional liquid coolers, this system delivers superior performance, ensuring more efficient and quieter cooling.

# Aller plus loin ensemble

## L’expertise industrielle française, au service des projets les plus exigeants depuis 1961

Créée en 1961, la société SOPIL est une société familiale basée à Pirey dans le Doubs, aux portes de Besançon.

D’abord une société d’outillage, l’entreprise a étendu son activité au découpage de petites pièces en métaux ferreux et alliages divers utilisés dans la connectique.

Les secteurs d’activités concernés sont l’automobile, l’industrie électrique, la téléphonie, le ferroviaire, l’aéronautique, le médical et l’électroménager.

Qualité, prix, délai, trois critères essentiels pris en compte par SOPIL pour fidéliser sa clientèle et assurer sa croissance.

SOPIL est inscrite dans la durée depuis 65 ans et met tout en œuvre pour vous assurer d’être encore votre partenaire pour les 65 prochaines années.

65 ans d'expérience

## Nos domaines d'expertise

  * ### Innovation

## Innovation

Exploration et résolution de problématiques métalliques complexes : étude des comportements matière, caractérisation, essais de traitements, simulation des déformations, optimisation des trajectoires d’outils et miniaturisation de géométries critiques. Développement de POC, prototypage rapide, analyse des dérives et validation industrielle. Intégration systématique du retour atelier pour stabiliser process et gains fonctionnels.

Découvrir

  * ### Développement

## Développement

Travail conjoint avec nos clients sur l’architecture produit/process : revue de conception, analyse matière, calcul des zones critiques, essai des procédés (contactage, clinchage, roulage), définition des jeux et calages, tests de densité énergétique pour le brasage ou la soudure. Itérations outillage-presse, mesures en métrologie, stabilisation des cadences et verrouillage QCD avant engagement série.

Découvrir

  * ### Outillage

## Outillage

Chaque élément d’un outil (architecture, poinçons, matrices, guidages/colonnes, éjecteurs, peignes, calages, lubrification, capteurs) est conçu, usiné et réglé en interne, suivi par fiche de vie et maintenu en préventif pour garantir stabilité dimensionnelle, cadence et longévité-outils garantis à vie.

Découvrir

  * ### Découpage

## Découpage

Réalisation de pièces métalliques complexes – en bandes ou en vrac – en alliages cuivreux (cuivre, laiton, bronze) et ferreux (acier, inox), pour des épaisseurs de 0,08 à 6 mm. Les process intègrent entre autres le contactage (rivetage/soudage), le taraudage et l’assemblage en ligne – sur presses de 25 à 315 tonnes – pour des composants prêts à intégrer, à tolérances serrées et cadences élevées.

Découvrir

  * ### Assemblage

## Assemblage

Assemblage sous presse et hors ligne : sertissage (crimping), clinchage, interlocking, rivetage, soudage par résistance ou induction, brasage argent/étain – pour fonctionnaliser les pièces, réduire les reprises et sécuriser la tenue électrique et mécanique.

Découvrir

## Nos domaines d'application

SOPIL accompagne la transformation des industries de pointe en concevant et produisant des composants métalliques à haute valeur ajoutée, issus d’un savoir-faire entièrement intégré.

Son expertise s’adresse à des marchés où la fiabilité, la propreté et la précision sont non-négociables : connectique, énergie, mobilité électrique, électronique, aéronautique, ferroviaire, médical ou encore luxe.

SOPIL se distingue par son hyperspécialisation dans la conception et l’industrialisation de solutions métalliques sur mesure, -outillages à suivre ou progressif et conçues pour les environnements les plus exigeants.

Au-delà de la découpe, l’entreprise mobilise son savoir-faire d’ingénierie pour transformer la complexité technique en performance industrielle, en intégrant le co-développement l'innovation et la maîtrise complète du process.

De la mobilité électrique à la domotique, de l’aéronautique au médical, des équipements intelligents aux nouvelles énergies, SOPIL anticipe les besoins des marchés en mutation et apporte des solutions fiables, durables et compétitives.

## SOPIL, expert français en outillage de presse de découpe et production de pièces découpées complexes depuis 1961

Depuis trois générations, SOPIL navigue avec agilité entre tradition familiale et innovation audacieuse pour s’adapter aux exigences actuelles de l’industrie tout en restant fidèle à ses racines. Entreprise familiale et indépendante implantée à Pirey, près de Besançon, dans l’Est de la France, SOPIL est spécialisée dans l’outillage de découpe technique et la fabrication de pièces metalliques complexes découpées, pour la connectique de signal et de puissance destinés aux environnements industriels les plus exigeants.

Six décennies à concevoir, produire et entretenir nos outils intégralement en interne, avec une garantie à vie. Cette maîtrise totale nous permet de piloter des process de découpage complexes - en bande ou en vrac - et d’apporter des solutions fiables et durables, conçues main dans la main avec nos clients, de l’étude initiale à la grande série.

## FAQ

What is the maximum speed of a STOER Bike?

The STOER E-Bikes have a maximum speed of 25 km/h. The motor, a 250-watt Bafang motor, stops supporting you as soon as you reach this speed. Above 25 km/h, you pedal on your own without motor support.

How many years of warranty is there on the bikes?

A new bicycle comes with a 2-year warranty on all non-wear-and-tear parts and a 5-year warranty on the frame.

Wear parts such as tires, brakes and accident damage are not covered. Sometimes there are slight differences from one dealer to another. So check where you bought the bike.

Is the optional lock approved for insurance?

The included ABUS lock meets ART-2 approval. Most insurance companies require an ART approved bicycle lock. This means that a bicycle lock must be approved by the ART Foundation. This foundation includes parties such as ANWB, BOVAG, insurers and police. This foundation extensively tests all locks to see if they are resistant to theft. A bicycle lock with ART-2 certification gives certainty about the theft protection of the lock.

Dutch ID e-bikes staan bekend om uitstekende kwaliteit en hoge betrouwbaarheid. Mochten er tóch onvoorziene omstandigheden zijn, dan geven we twee jaar garantie. Niet alleen het frame, de voorvork en productiefouten, maar ook de motor en bedieningsdisplay (het elektrische gedeelte) vallen onder de garantie.

Slijtage aan delen zoals versnellingsnaaf, ketting- en kettingbladen, banden en remsystemen zijn uitgezonderd van de garantie. Als de accu, een slijtagedeel, stuk gaat geven wij twee jaar garantie.

WARNING

• Observe the locally applicable (cycle) traffic rules at all times, including the rules for bike lighting.  
• Consult the local regulations for the registration and use of e-bikes on public roads.  
• Verify that the head tube lighting is permitted in your cycling country. If required, your dealer can permanently disable the head tube lighting.  
• Always turn on the bike lighting when using the e-bike in the dark. Cycling in the dark without lighting is very dangerous, due to the poor visibility of the road surface and poor visibility for other road users.  
• The head tube lighting does not serve as a replacement for the front lamp. Always use normal bike lighting when it is dark or in poor visibility.  
• Ensure that your front light is not angled at such a height that it shines directly into the eyes of oncoming road users. This can dazzle them, which may lead to hazardous situations or accidents.  
• Disc brakes are more powerful than traditional brakes. Try out the brakes during the test cycle so you know how hard you must squeeze and how powerful the brakes are. Check and remember carefully which brake levers operate the front and rear brakes.  
• The brake discs have sharp edges. To prevent cuts, do not touch the brake discs without protection.  
• When fitting or adjusting the saddle, one bolt must be tightened to secure the saddle.  
  - If the bolt is tightened tighter than specified, there is a risk of overtightening. This could cause the bolt to break in case of prolonged heavy loading while cycling.

This can lead to dangerous situations. The specified tightening torque can be found on the seatpost and all bicycle tightening torques can be found in Appendix 2 of this manual. Check once a month to make sure the saddle is tight, but do not tighten harder than prescribed. If you do not have a torque wrench, have your dealer check the saddle fastener at every service.

## Product overview 

Centreline Aluminium guarding is a modular construction that provides a physical barrier for enclosed and fenced off constructions in industrial facilities. Aluminium guarding provides a secure and fast solution for machine guarding applications. With its smooth aesthetic anodised finish aluminium guarding is a favoured guarding solution for manufacturers. 

Common installations of our Aluminium guarding include:

  * Mill guards
  * Automated cells
  * Warehouse partitioning

Our Aluminium Section guarding is constructed from a hard anodised aluminium extrusion frame. The application bodes a lightweight durable design that delivers long lasting quality.

For infill options, choose from aluminium extrusion, sheet steel, polycarbonate, welded or woven mesh, glass, wood or a combination of all three. Each infill can be built from 1 mm to 8 mm thick, with the ability for interchangeable infills for maximum versatility.   * From our range, products offering integration compatibility with Centre-Line Aluminium Guarding Section are Roller Doors, Pneumatic Rise and Fall Doors, Conveyor System, Platforms, Electrical, and safety features.

# Pneumatic Rise and Fall Doors

* * *

Click Here to View Gallery

* * *

Centreline Rise and Fall Doors are pneumatic systems d esigned to provide a physical barrier for automated manufacturing processes. Each system delivers a secure, aesthetic, and cost-effective solution to guarding machinery that at the point of entry requires frequent operator access.

Our Rise and Fall Doors are commonly installed for

  * Robot cell stations
  * Part assembly
  * Power press and conveyor loading
  * Conveyor openings.

With each Rise and Fall Door, a 'safe edge' system can be fitted to return the door to its open position should the closure sequence be interrupted. As standard, we supply two safety limit switches that should be interlocked into the machine circuitry to interlock the door system. Interlocking prevents machine operation until the door is completely secure. We have a wide range of safety features available to install depending on the usage and safety requirements of the system. 

The selection of infill materials is dependent on two key areas the first is the potential hazards needing containment and two the usage of the system. Each rise and fall door uses a high-quality aluminium extrusion frame with infill options comprising of sheet steel, poly-carbonate, glass, or a mixture of the three. Welded or woven mesh is not considered a suitable material due to the risk posed by panel movement and the inherent trapping hazard that this would create. 

All our systems are compliant to the latest machine directives as standard and can be accompanied with a decoration of conformity.

## AUDIRA

# Listen to what you have never seen before

Image

Industry’s first and only in-line, non-destructive subsurface metrology system for advanced semiconductor manufacturing. The AUDIRA system provides highly accurate and reproducible nanometer-level measurements of buried features and defects, such as voids, in advanced memory and logic devices.

AUDIRA combines an acoustic microscopy technique with our own proprietary atomic force microscopy (AFM) technology. The AFM probe is used to ‘listen’ to the sound waves coming through the wafer layers. The wave interacts with all the transitions and surfaces within the device and reflects information back. The pattern of that reflected wave and the time of arrival contains data about the structure below the surface. AUDIRA scans across the die, with each step as small as several tenths of a nanometer. The data is then translated into a comprehensive pattern of the underlying layers that provides measurement of subsurface features.

AUDIRA is also valuable for measuring shallow features through the surface. Using the AFM probe, surface elasticity variations can be quickly measured to reveal details about the structure below. Nearfield Instruments works with customers to develop a recipe for when to use acoustics and at what frequency, for which layers local elasticity measurements are best, and when to switch to wave propagation schemes.

AUDIRA is available for ordering now.

## Quadra

# Automated High-Throughput 3D Scanning Probe Metrology

Image

## 3D

### High-Aspect Ratio CD Metrology

The big metrology challenges associated with manufacturing Gate-All-Around FETs include high aspect ratio processes, sub surface 3D features and aggressive pitches.
Nearfield Instruments’ newly developed Feedforward Trajectory Planner (FFTP) imaging mode enables on-device, non-destructive measurements to be used for in-line process monitoring of GAA FETs at 3nm and beyond.

## PRECISION

### Stability and Repeatability

As a benchmark, “noise floor”, using a “zero scan”, has been used to assess AFM performance. But noise floor does not represent tool precision, repeatability, variation from strong scanning stage reaction forces in high speed imaging, reloading the wafer, and long-term drift, all influencing measurement quality. Revolutionary mechatronic concepts in QUADRA’s architecture enable industry-best measurement precision and reproducibility.

## THROUGHPUT

### Speed and Productivity

Time to information is crucial. QUADRA’s architecture of miniaturized high-speed SPMs working in parallel increases throughput 100-fold compared to other automated single-probe AFM metrology tools for targeted in-line metrology applications. It also features high-speed navigation to the POI, probe exchange/alignment and unique data visualization to further increase productivity.

## SIDEWALL IMAGING MODE

  * As semiconductor devices evolve into increasingly complex 3D architectures, metrology solutions need to advance to provide more comprehensive and full 3D profile insight.

  * Transmission Electron Microscopy (T.E.M.) delivers high-resolution 3D reference data, while Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) enables non-destructive surface characterization — yet neither provides non-destructive, in-line full 3D profiling, especially in extreme high aspect ratio structures.

  * Building on the foundation of our propietary feed-forward trajectory planner (FFTP) mode, Nearfield Instruments introduces Sidewall Imaging Mode, combining sidewall force sensing, and advanced sensor fusion to determine the probe’s precise position in 3D space.

  * The result is full 3D, non-destructive, in-line profile measurement — from individual features to full wafers — expanding process insight and strengthening manufacturing control.

Hybrid bonding has moved from experimental demonstrations to deployment in several device categories:

DRAM
Transitioning from TSVs and microbumps toward hybrid bonding for multi-die

Logic & Heterogeneous Integration
Hybrid bonding underpins advanced chiplet-to-wafer and wafer-to-wafer 
approaches that combine logic, memory, and accelerators to integrates compute 
and memory at fine pitches to meet AI and HPC requirements.
Backside PDN
Hybrid bonding enables low-resistance copper connections for backside power 
delivery networks, reducing IR drop and providing improving power efficient 
power delivery directly to in advanced logic transistors through wafer backside 
interconnects.

## Segments

The management of business activities and the corresponding reporting are broken down into the Technology and Services segments at the technotrans Group. These segments are the principal management and reporting entities, which are assessed on the basis of segment sales and segment EBIT.

The Technology segment covers development and production activities. The bulk of the systems manufactured are cooling and temperature control systems covering a performance range of 0.1 kW to 5,000 kW. These systems extend over a temperature range from -80 °C to +430 °C and achieve control accuracy of 0.01 K to 1.0 K. technotrans also builds systems for pumping, spraying or conditioning liquids, often used in combination with its thermal management systems. The Technology segment brought in around 76 % of consolidated revenue in the 2025 financial year.

The Services segment comprises a comprehensive portfolio of services through which technotrans provides its customers with all-round support for everything from installation and commissioning to modernisation and repair or maintenance tasks. The round-the-clock worldwide supply of parts is a key aspect of these services. This segment also includes the full-service offering of the Group company gds for Technical Documentation, including the compilation of technical documents in all major foreign languages and the accompanying content management and content delivery software. In the 2025 financial year, the Services segment brought in around 24 % of consolidated revenue.

## Introduction

Welcome to the world of blogging! Blogging is a rewarding journey. It allows you to express yourself, share your knowledge, and connect with like-minded individuals. ## 3. Use Headings and Subheadings

Break your content into smaller sections using headings and subheadings. This improves readability and also allows you to incorporate secondary keywords.

## 4. Mobile-Friendly and Fast Loading

With the increasing use of mobile devices, ensure your blog is mobile-friendly. Also, a fast-loading site improves user experience and SEO rankings.

## 5. Internal and External Linking

Link to other relevant posts within your blog (internal linking) and to authoritative external sources. This not only provides value to your readers but also boosts your SEO.

## 6. Image Optimization

Use relevant images and optimize them with descriptive file names and alt tags containing your keywords.

## 7. Regularly Update Your Content

Search engines favor regularly updated websites. Keep your content fresh and up-to-date.

## 8. Use Social Media to Boost Visibility

Promote your posts on social media. This increases your content’s reach and can indirectly improve your SEO through increased traffic.

  * #### What does the Renol® masterbatch contain?

Renol® is made from 100% biobased materials: lignin and biobased oils. When we supply Renol® as a masterbatch, we blend it with a carrier polymer (the plastic material our customer will blend our Renol® with, in this case ABS).

We offer two masterbatches with either virgin or recycled ABS blended with Renol®.

  * #### Are Renol® pellets biodegradable?

No, Renol® pellets are primarily biobased, but they are not biodegradable according to EN standards. However, this is actually a benefit, as they are designed to be recyclable, contributing to a circular economy rather than breaking down into the environment.

Our material is ideal for applications that don’t require high-gloss finishes. It offers a refined colour range, from soft greys, pastels and to deep browns and blacks.

We focus on cradle-to-gate because it reflects the stages of production we directly control and take responsibility for, up until the material leaves our facility. What happens beyond that—how the material is used and disposed of—depends on the end user, which is outside our direct control.

Q&A

### 

Why do we need electric roads?

Electric roads are emerging as a key solution to some of the biggest challenges in e-mobility. Traditional charging methods, like cord-based systems, require extensive space for charging stations and strain the power grid, especially during peak usage. Electric road systems (ERS) offer a more efficient alternative, particularly for long-range charging on highways and major public roads. They seamlessly integrate into existing road infrastructure, allowing for a more flexible power distribution to vehicles. This not only enables a faster rollout of battery electric vehicles (BEVs) but also reduces costs. As a result, ERS technology is increasingly recognized as crucial for achieving the ambitious targets set by the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and beyond.

Q&A

### 

How does conductive charging work with Elonroad's solution?

Our system interfaces with the Combined Charging System (CCS), but supplies energy through an energy collector instead of a conventional plug. This collector is mounted beneath the vehicle, which lowers to connect with Elonroad's stationary charging rail. The vehicle can still use its regular charging inlet for cable charging but not at the same time.

Our story

Image

Since the first electrical vehicles entered the market more than a decade ago, the question on everyone’s minds has been – ”How far can you drive?” Batteries are expensive and take up a lot of space. Batteries, costly yet pivotal, create a barrier to widespread adoption. At Elonroad, we're determined to change this narrative.   

In the heart of innovation, inspiration often strikes unexpectedly. For our founder, Dan Zethraeus, that moment of insight came on a snow-laden road. A radical idea crystallized as slush accumulated between the wheels: "Could we charge electric vehicles differently?" Armed with a basic understanding of electrical engineering and boundless imagination, Dan embarked on a journey redefining transportation as we know it.

"It got me thinking," recalls Dan, his eyes alight with passion. "Perhaps you could build a rail there to conduct electricity under my car?" With a handful of Lego bricks and a mind buzzing with possibilities, he created the first prototype.

At that moment, our electric road system was born, transcending the limitations of conventional charging stations.  Our story is not just about wires and circuits; it's about inspiring change.

Scopri la tecnologia

I nostri pannelli fotovoltaici sono concepiti per fornire le massime prestazioni nel minor spazio possibile.

L'innovativa tecnologia Enecom si basa su un processo di laminazione che "incapsula" le celle fotovoltaiche in un “sandwich” di film plastici ad alta resistenza.
Grazie a questo procedimento, i moduli fotovoltaici non hanno bisogno di alcun tipo di cornice o supporto e risultano sottilissimi, leggerissimi e flessibili.

## Materiali

I materiali applicati alla parte in pressione (serbatoio e flange accoppiamento) e al riscaldatore variano a seconda delle condizioni di funzionamento:

  * acciaio al carbonio e/o basso legato per condizioni a bassa temperatura e fluidi non corrosivi.
  * acciaio inossidabile per fluidi aggressivi e temperature elevate (Aisi 304 – 316L).
  * titanio per applicazioni settore marino.

Per gli elementi riscaldanti (fascio elettrico riscaldante) possono essere utilizzati:

  * materiali austenitici quali AISI 321 per fluidi corrosivi ed elevate temperature
  * materiali austenitici quali AISI 316L per fluidi corrosivi e basse temperature
  * leghe nobili quali incoloy 800 per impianti ad alta temperatura
  * titanio per impianti navali ad utilizzo acqua salata.

La custodia elettrica dei collegamenti del riscaldatore può essere in:

  * acciaio al carbonio verniciato con vernice zinco allumino
  * acciaio inossidabile Aisi 304.

## Protezione

La custodia elettrica dei collegamenti del riscaldatore, in base alla temperatura massima di funzionamento dell’impianto, può essere a diretto contatto con la flangia del riscaldatore oppure in esecuzione rinviata “testa fredda”. Il grado di protezione può essere IP55, IP65 o IP66 con relativa guarnizione di chiusura a tenuta.

## Accessori

Ogni scambiatore viene fornito con gli accessori necessari per un’installazione sicura e completa, tra cui:

  * sostegni della coibentazione nel materiale più idoneo al luogo d’installazione
  * golfari di sollevamento dello scambiatore
  * selle di sostegno del serbatoio per il fissaggio meccanico dello scambiatore
  * strumentazione di controllo del processo (sensori termici)
  * eventuali attacchi al serbatoio (sfiato e drenaggio).   

## Documentazione

Per gli scambiatori elettrici è fornita la seguente documentazione all’interno del fascicolo certificativo finale che accompagna il prodotto:

  * dichiarazione di conformità
  * manuale uso e manutenzione
  * istruzioni di sicurezza
  * disegni d’assieme scambiatore
  * schede tecniche dei componenti utilizzati e relative dichiarazioni di conformità dei fornitori
  * internal test Report.

### In 1947, Renato GHISALBA set up his company in Turin, marking the beginning of an activity  destined to leave its mark. # Behind the scenes of the production process

16 April 2024

On a typical workday at ITALWATT, all staff face daily challenges to provide the best service to customers. Each customer has their own habits, procedures, reflections of the culture, and market to which they refer. However, a common factor is the uncompromising commitment to the quality of the result, compliance with military requirements, and the promptness with which products must be delivered to meet the obligations of the end user.

Each customer has the space to express their goals, the technical needs of the products, and the requirements that the device or system to be created must meet. Sales & Proposal technicians make an initial assessment, drawing on the product catalog and proposing a solution. This is further developed with the engineering office, which builds a documented technical solution that is discussed with the customer. Once the goals are aligned and the road map agreed upon, the design activity begins in earnest, until the construction of prototypes: these will be subjected to careful analysis by the customer, who is responsible for verifying that expectations are met.

Some time is then spent building additional units for sending to an accredited laboratory: it is important to ensure that all requirements are met and that the product is qualified according to military standards.

Meanwhile, Production & Logistics get into the thick of the action: as soon as the project is recognized as meeting all requirements, we are ready to produce them in quantity, just in time for delivery to the customer and installation on the vehicle. We are proud of every single product that comes off our production line: each of them is a testament to a story of collaboration, success, and satisfaction between us and our customers.

Yes BCH designs and manufacturers all of its equipment in house at our UK site. Our teams work closely with customers to ensure equipment is manufactured to required needs. Our Innovation Centre also supports product development, equipment testing and process validation.

▸Where is BCH based and do they supply equipment internationally?

BCH is located in Whitworth, Lancashire, United Kingdom and supplies food and confectionery processing equipment worldwide. We support customers across Europe, North America, the Middle East and other international markets.

▸How quickly can BCH vacuum cooling systems chill food to a safe temperature?

BCH Vacuum Cooling systems typically cool from 90°C to 5°C or below in as little as 30 – 45 minutes, product dependent. The speed of cooling in a sealed environment offers swift passage through the temperature danger zone.

▸What types of food can be cooled using vacuum cooling technology?

Vacuum Cooling is ideal for products such as soups, sauces, ready meals, rice dishes, vegetables, pet food, meat based products and stews. 
▸How does the FlexiChef system work with Cook Cool equipment?

Flexichef is BCH’s recipe control system that provides even more flexibility in the creation of recipes. FlexiChef allows for complete control and automation over the cook process to ensure consistent and repeatable results in every batch. When combined with a Cook/Cool system, FlexiChef allows for control of key cooking parameters such as different stages, times and processes as well as data tracking and downloadable reports, alarms, trends and password protected levels for different levels of access / control.

▸What types of food can be produced using a Cook Cool system?

Several products can be produced on the Cook Cool including sauces, soups, rice, stocks, vegetables, pasta, noodles, ready meals, pie fillings, pet food and curries.

▸What capacity Cook Cool systems does BCH manufacture?

The BCH Cook Cool System can have working capacities between 10 and 5000 litres dependent on product requirements and factory floor space. Bespoke sizes are available if required and this can be discussed with a sales engineer.
